coordinateSystem: Top-left origin; integer logical pixels; nearest-neighbour sampling

01-bosun.description: Broad, bareheaded; deep brown skin, black cropped hair, navy waistcoat over cream sleeveless top.
01-bosun.layout: Identical atlas coordinates and frame sizes to deck.json; both base and outfit slots carry this identity; other pixels transparent
01-bosun.feetRegistration: Bottom eight sampled rows (both boots, including lifted boot) centred at each existing frame feet.x; feet.y unchanged
01-bosun.limitations: Separate generated poses, not a newly authored walk cycle. Fixed narrow side and leaning slots compress some silhouettes; artist polish recommended for movement. Front views serve north/south, right profile mirrored for left as in current crew.

main-sail.layering: Draw hull, then sail, then depth-sorted crew and pieces. When sail is enabled, substitute mast-occluder.png for the original mast depth piece so it cannot overpaint the canvas. Keep the original mast when sail is disabled.

animation.attachmentMotion: Inherit whole-ship bob; do not inherit masthead sway (masthead ends at y48).

main-sail.limitations: Partially reefed low square sail preserves open deck. Two-frame subtle cloth shimmer, not a physical full sailing rig.

mastOccluder.processing: Exact original mast pixels, with local rows 0..24 (hull y48..72) transparent; remaining pixels unchanged.

provenance.normalization: C# System.Drawing. Source regions cropped at alpha>=128; block-sampled with median opaque RGB and majority alpha>=128; nearest squared-RGB distance into the 48 opaque deck colours; no dithering. Crew fits existing frame sizes, with per-identity front width caps 16/14/14/16/15/14 and bottom-eight-row boot pivot alignment; width reduced if necessary to avoid clipping. Sail alpha bounds sampled to 114x27; second frame yard rows 0..6 and both corner regions copied from first frame to lock attachment.
